sharedWidgets.purpose: The per-screen frame every route shares: hidden-scrollbar vertical scroll view with the canonical page insets, the one-shot bRise entry animation on the content column, the bottom scrim, the floating glass nav, and an optional pinned overlay slot (Pit FAB / Post composer).
constructorParams: double blockGap  // 22 Home, 24 Market, 20 Company, 20 Pit, 18 Post, 20 Reader, 22 You, 22 States — verified per-screen in the canvas, there is NO single value
Widget? pinnedOverlay  // Pit FAB (z8, end:20 bottom:108) or Post composer (z6, inset16 bottom:104)
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: Stack z-order: scroll body (0) -> bottom scrim (z5, h118) -> pinned overlay (z6 composer / z8 FAB) -> glass nav (z7) -> status bar (z6, parity only). Scroll padding EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16,54,16,124) => 358pt content width on a 390pt device. ScrollConfiguration(...copyWith(scrollbars:false)); the canvas kills scrollbars globally via `*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;display:none}` + `scrollbar-width:none`. Content = Column(crossAxisAlignment: stretch) with `blockGap` SizedBox separators. Entry = FadeTransition + SlideTransition(Offset(0, 4/height) -> Offset.zero), 240ms, Curves.easeOut, ONE controller for the whole column — the canvas never staggers per section. On device replace 54 with MediaQuery.padding.top; 124 = 22 (nav bottom) + 66 (nav height) + 36 clearance.

sharedWidgets.purpose: The single screen-entry motion of the whole app: a 4px rise plus fade, played once on the route's root column.
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: @keyframes bRise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}} 240ms ease-out. sharedWidgets.purpose: The placeholder identity mark used everywhere instead of photos or initials: a circle filled with 135° two-tone stripes.
constructorParams: double bandWidth = 3  // 3 for size <= 34, 4 for size >= 46
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: ClipOval + CustomPainter drawing bands at 135°; period = 2*bandWidth. Flutter has no repeating-linear-gradient; a LinearGradient with TileMode.repeated + GradientRotation must be sized so one period spans exactly 6 or 8 logical px, which differs per avatar — a px-parameterised CustomPainter is the correct model. Home's avatar stack adds two more pairs: #CFC7BE/#E0D9D1 (2nd disc) and #DED7CF/#EFE9E2 (3rd), each with a 2px OUTER ring in #F7F4F0 (box-shadow 0 0 0 2px), so each disc's real footprint is 30px on a 17px pitch (26 - 9).

sharedWidgets.purpose: Border factories that translate every CSS `inset box-shadow` rule in the design. Flutter has no inset shadow, so all of them become 1px Borders.
constructorParams: BHairline.rowTop()  // Pit card footer .08 / Post detail meta row .10
BHairline.onDarkTop()  // BorderSide(Color(0x14F5F1EC), 1) — rgba(245,241,236,.08), Company header stat strip
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: Exact sources: `inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.08)` on Market disclosure rows, Company filing rows, You watchlist + notification rows — applied to EVERY row INCLUDING THE LAST on all three screens, so a hairline always sits 4px above the grouped card's bottom edge. Never use ListView.separated. `inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.10)` = Company financials header. `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.08)` = Pit post-card footer (padding-top 14). `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.10)` = Post detail engagement row (padding-top 14). `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(245,241,236,.08)` = Company dark header stat strip (padding-top 14). `inset 1px 0 0 rgba(27,25,23,.14)` + padding-start 18 = Post detail nested comment (per-comment only; the 20px gaps between comments are unruled). sharedWidgets.purpose: The house press feedback. Every tappable surface in the design scales down; nothing ripples.
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: GestureDetector(onTapDown/onTapUp/onTapCancel) driving AnimatedScale. NEVER InkWell — there is no material ink anywhere in this design and a ripple on a dark gradient card or on #F7F4F0 paper reads wrong. Exact scales: 0.98/220ms (Home hero, Home watchlist tiles, Home Pit-preview cards, Home research rail cards, Company research cards, Market sector cards); 0.99/220ms (Market company row, Pit post card); 0.94/200ms (Home refresh button); 0.94/220ms (Pit FAB). Two traps: (1) the Pit post card animates as a whole but has NO tap handler — only its ticker chip and its title/excerpt block do, so drive the press from a Listener on the card and keep two GestureDetectors inside; (2) Home's ORAS + TMGH tiles, Market's sector cards, Company's post cards, You's dark research card and States' CTA all *look* pressable in the canvas but are inert or missing the transform — treat the omissions as design gaps, wire them, and flag the deviations.

sharedWidgets.purpose: The signature 56-blade 180° tick gauge. Two canvas configurations exist — Company's 52-week range (size 214) and the Reader's Cash-or-Trash verdict (size 230) — plus the signed research-score mode the real product needs.
constructorParams: required String big  // pre-formatted; sign formatting is the caller's job
sharedWidgets.stylingSummary: Box = size x (size/2 + 46) => 214x153 and 230x161. Pivot at (size/2, height - 22) => (107,131) and (115,139). N = 56 blades; blade i angle = -90° + i*180/55 (3.2727° step; i=0 due WEST, i=55 due EAST; because N is even there is NO centre blade — the 0° axis falls between i=27 (-1.636°) and i=28 (+1.636°)). Each blade is a 2 x round(size*0.145) rounded rect (radius 1) at the FAR end of a size/2 rod, occupying radius 76..107 @214 (tick 31) and 82..115 @230 (tick 33). filled = round(56 * clamp((value-min)/(max-min), 0, 1)) => 43 lit @Company (65.42 in 41.10..72.80, ratio .76719) and 40 lit @Reader (72 in 0..100). Lit #E8621C; unlit rgba(245,241,236,0.16)=0x29F5F1EC and never animated. bTick: per-blade colour lerp from the unlit tone to lit, 220ms Curves.easeOut (NOT easeOutCubic), delay i*9ms — one controller of 598ms (Company, last lit blade starts at 378ms) / 571ms (Reader, 351ms), driving Interval(i*9/total, (i*9+220)/total). Centre readout: Positioned(bottom:46, start:0, end:0) centred Column — value Outfit w200, fontSize round(size*0.2) (46 @230, 43 @214), height 1.0, ls -0.03em (-1.38 / -1.29), #F5F1EC, tabular; caption margin-top 7, IBM w400 9/1 ls 1.44 uppercase #8E8781. lo at (start:2, bottom:0), hi at (end:2, bottom:0), both IBM w400 10/1 #8E8781 tabular. Build as ONE CustomPainter inside a RepaintBoundary — not 56 widgets — and wrap in Directionality(TextDirection.ltr) so the axis and the sweep never mirror. sharedWidgets.purpose: The capsule search affordance — a display-only row on Market and a query echo on States. No input, no focus state exists in the design.

risks: ARC GAUGE, SIGNED RE-SCALE — the highest-risk item. The canvas dial() is west-anchored: ratio = (value-min)/(max-min) and filled = round(56*ratio), so naively passing min=-S, max=+S makes a score of 0 light blades 0..27 — half the arc — reading as 'half good'. The correct model is centre-anchored: mag = (v.abs()/S).clamp(0,1); k = (28*mag).round(); light [28, 27+k] for v>=0 and [28-k, 27] for v<0. Because N=56 is EVEN there is no centre blade — the 0deg axis falls exactly between i=27 (-1.636deg) and i=28 (+1.636deg) — so a dedicated static zero marker must be drawn there or the origin is invisible. The stagger must also be re-indexed to distanceFromCentre*9ms so the bar grows outward instead of sweeping from the west, and `big` must be sign-formatted ('+20', '-6') since the canvas passes a pre-formatted string. At S=50 the quantum is 1.79 points per blade, so a -6 score lights only 3 blades; decide whether any non-zero score gets a minimum 1-blade fill. None of this exists in the design file — it is all new behaviour that must be reviewed, not inferred.

ARC GAUGE, GEOMETRY AND ANIMATION. 56 blades must be one CustomPainter in a RepaintBoundary, not 56 Transform widgets. The blade is NOT a radial line from the centre: it is a 2 x round(size*0.145) capsule at the FAR end of a size/2 rod, occupying radius 76..107 at size 214 and 82..115 at size 230, pivoting at (size/2, height-22) where height = size/2 + 46. Angles step 180/55 = 3.2727deg from -90 to +90. The reveal is 56 independent 220ms Curves.easeOut colour lerps offset 9ms each, driven from one controller via Interval(i*9/total, (i*9+220)/total) with total 598ms (Company) / 571ms (Reader) — a single global tween will not reproduce it. Curves.easeOutCubic is visibly snappier than CSS ease-out; use Curves.easeOut. Unlit blades must never animate.

BACKDROP BLUR. Three surfaces need it: the nav bar (every screen), the Post detail composer (same screen as the nav, so two full-width saveLayers stacked), and the Home hero's frosted overlay pills. CSS blur radius is ~2 sigma, so blur(26px) -> sigma 13 and blur(14px) -> sigma 7. `saturate(180%)` has NO ImageFilter equivalent — either compose a ColorFilter.matrix saturation matrix through ImageFilter.compose or accept flatter glass, and decide that once rather than per screen. BackdropFilter samples everything painted beneath it and is clipped by its nearest ancestor clip, so it must be inside a ClipRRect(999) or it blurs the whole screen. Worst case, on Post detail, two blurred capsules sit over a scrolling list on mid-range Android — budget for it, keep both in RepaintBoundaries, and never place one behind scrolling content.

INSET BOX-SHADOWS DO NOT EXIST IN FLUTTER, AND THE REPLACEMENT CHANGES LAYOUT. Eleven distinct inset rules across the design become 1px Borders — but a CSS inset shadow costs zero layout box while a Flutter Border expands the child's constraints. Two places where this actually breaks the design: the outlined kind chips grow 2px in each axis (padding must drop from 5x11 to 4x10, or the stroke must be painted via ShapeDecoration/CustomPaint to keep the exact padding), and the financials table's 44px row height drifts. Also note the hairline is drawn on EVERY row INCLUDING THE LAST in Market disclosures, Company filings and both You lists — reproduce or explicitly decide against it, but never silently 'fix' it with ListView.separated.

TABULAR NUMERALS ARE NOT GUARANTEED. Outfit ships here as a single variable TTF and IBM Plex Sans Arabic as three statics; if either lacks the `tnum` feature, FontFeature.tabularFigures() is a silent no-op and every right-aligned price column (Market A–Z, Company financials, You watchlist) will jitter as digits change. Verify before building the rows, and have a fallback (fixed-width numeral column via SizedBox, or a monospaced numeral fallback family). Separately, because Outfit is variable, w200 and w300 must be requested via FontVariation('wght', 200/300) — relying on fontWeight alone can snap to the nearest named instance and quietly thicken every display heading in the app.

RTL WITH LATIN TICKERS BESIDE ARABIC NAMES. Four screens put a Latin ticker, a Latin price and a dir=rtl Arabic company name in the same row (Home tiles, Market rows, Company header, You watchlist). Under an Arabic locale the row itself mirrors and the Latin runs become embedded LTR — without U+2066/U+2069 isolates, 'SWDY' and '65.42' will reorder unpredictably against their Arabic neighbour, and strings like '▲ 1.16 (1.80%)' and '7.4×' will move the arrow and swap the parentheses. Compounding it: letterSpacing (.16em eyebrows, .06em chips, .02em tickers) breaks Arabic joining and must be gated on script, and text-transform:uppercase must be skipped. Also directional: the '‹'/'›' chevrons, the magnifier, the nav pill's translateX(n*100%), the nested-comment leading rail, the Save item's margin-left:auto, the FAB's right:20, the financials frozen column, and the You watchlist's handle/remove pair. The gauge, the financials numerals and the time-axis bar chart should be LTR-locked deliberately, not mirrored by default.

GRADIENT-ON-DARK CHART FILLS AND NON-UNIFORM SCALING. The Home hero area chart needs a Path closed down to y=164 filled with a vertical Shader from Color(0xFFE8621C).withOpacity(0.26) to fully transparent #E8621C — Flutter's default transparent is 0x00000000, so lerping to Colors.transparent produces a grey-black smear instead of a clean orange fade; the second stop must be Color(0x00E8621C). Both the hero chart and the sparklines use preserveAspectRatio="none": the hero is 318x164 at 1:1, but the sparklines are a 130x34 viewBox rendered at 141x34, i.e. x stretched by 1.0846 with y unscaled. A FittedBox or any uniform fit will be visibly wrong; the painter must map dx = x/vbW*size.width and dy = y/vbH*size.height independently.

FROZEN-COLUMN TABLE. Company financials wants a 132pt label column pinned to the leading edge AND a header row pinned to the top of a horizontally scrolling 4-column body, with a 420pt track against a ~318pt viewport. Flutter has no `position:sticky`: this needs either an outer Row of [fixed label Column | Expanded horizontal scroll] with the header duplicated so both halves stay in lockstep, or two linked ScrollControllers. Rows are exactly 44px, so the BHairline layout-expansion issue bites here first. There is also a real defect to resolve: the FY25 header cell uses padding-right 20 while its body cells use 16, so that column's header sits 4px out of alignment with its own values.

DARK MODE IS ENTIRELY UNVERIFIED. The canvas header calls the product 'dark-first' but every one of the eight screens is drawn light; there is not a single dark token in the file. Every dark value in the table above is a derivation, and two of them are genuinely risky. First, `up` #3F6B52 and `down` #A3402F both fail contrast on #1B1917 and must be lifted ~30 L*, which changes their character from muted-editorial to noticeably brighter — get that signed off, because those two colours are the only semantic colours in the app. Second and more structural: in the light theme 'raised' means DARK (#242120->#1B1917 on paper). In a dark theme that inversion has nowhere to go — the editorial hero card can no longer be 'the dark one'. The proposed surface/surfaceRaised split keeps the elevation but loses the light theme's core contrast gesture; that is an information-architecture decision, not a colour swap.

fl_chart IS ALREADY A DEPENDENCY AND CANNOT BUILD ANY CHART IN THIS DESIGN. The arc gauge (56 discrete staggered blades), the hero area chart (non-uniform viewBox scaling, no axes, no grid, no tooltip), the four sparklines, and both bar charts (no axis line, no gridlines, no value labels, one inked bar) are all hand-painted. Reaching for fl_chart will produce something that looks generically like a chart and nothing like this design. Either remove the dependency or scope it to something outside these eight screens.

BOX MODEL AND ch UNITS. Verified in the source: box-sizing:border-box appears on only five elements, and the Reader's chart card is not one of them — so its `height:120px` is CONTENT height (the bar row is 156px overall) and every bar fraction resolves against 120. Getting this wrong scales all seven bars by 0.77. Separately, `max-width:34ch` on the Reader dek and `62ch` on its body paragraphs have no px equivalent: ch is the advance of '0' in IBM Plex Sans Arabic at 15px and 16px and must be measured with a TextPainter. The 34ch dek cap almost certainly binds at 358pt; the 62ch body cap almost certainly does not — but that must be measured, not assumed.

PRESS FEEDBACK AND HIT TARGETS. There is no material ink anywhere, so InkWell is banned across all eight screens — a ripple on a dark gradient card or on #F7F4F0 paper is immediately wrong. The scales are inconsistent by design (0.98 / 0.99 / 0.94) and several elements look pressable but are inert in the canvas (Home ORAS + TMGH tiles, Market sector cards, Company post cards and filing rows, You saved-research light card, the 'Edit'/'Undo'/'Manage' links, the Home refresh button, the Company overflow menu, the Pit FAB, the whole composer bar). Each is a decision, not a bug to fix silently. Also: the 42px icon buttons, the 12px text actions and the 11px comment actions are all below the 44pt minimum and need hit areas expanded outward without shifting the surrounding rhythm.

THREE COLOUR-ONLY STATES VIOLATE THE PRODUCT'S OWN RULE. The Reader save toggle inverts fill only (#F7F4F0/#1B1917) with no icon or label change; the You notification toggle differs only by track colour and knob position with no glyph or text; the Post detail like state changes only #7A736D -> #E8621C on an unchanged ▲. Everything else in the design pairs colour with a glyph or word (▲/▼ deltas, the 'Cash' gauge caption, 'Under review', the segmented labels), so these three are outliers and should be fixed — filled-vs-outline bookmark, an On/Off label or knob glyph, a filled-vs-outline triangle — before ship, not after.

SEMANTIC POLARITY OF up/down IS INVERTED IN THE SEED DATA. Company's 'Net debt 12.9bn ▲ 8.8%' is flagged up/green while the financials table shows net debt FALLING 14,120 -> 12,880. The flag means favourable/unfavourable, not increased/decreased. If BChangeDelta takes a single boolean, the arrow renders backwards the first time real data arrives on any balance-sheet metric. Model sentiment and direction as two separate fields from day one — this is the kind of error that is invisible in review and obvious to a user.

PER-SCREEN CONSTANTS THAT LOOK LIKE TOKENS BUT ARE NOT. Verified in the source: the root column gap is 22 / 24 / 20 / 20 / 18 / 20 / 22 / 22 across Home / Market / Company / Pit / Post / Reader / You / States. Card shadow alpha is .06 on five screens and .08 on three. Chip padding is 5x10 or 4x10 on Home and Company but 5x11 on Pit and Post. The ember chip border is .50 on Home and .55 everywhere else. Research-card title size is 21, 22 or 20 depending on surface, with a 36px / 12px / 10px kicker gap. Every one of these is a place where a well-meaning 'consolidation' silently retypesets a screen. Expose them as parameters with the per-screen values documented, and change them only as an explicit, reviewed decision.
